reflection.delta: The production controller and initial gate existed, but public time-travel semantics, the cross-runtime fixture, and the change-specific security boundary were absent. The first final-fixture gate run also exposed a generated ESM consumer missing its createRequire import.
reflection.root_cause: Implementation-first sequencing intentionally deferred public artifacts, the prior fixture covered entity inspection only, and a broad patch inserted createRequire into the root-only generated file rather than the full ESM generated file.
corrective_actions: Added package, skills, human API, fixture, security, and verification content derived from production source.
Published a byte-identical TypeScript/Flutter time-travel fixture and made the packed ESM flow consume its real import envelope.
Corrected the generated-consumer import at the observed failing boundary and reran the complete packed gate successfully.
Verified unchanged built root and optional runtime export ledgers.
Recursively validated every acceptance status and matched both source fixtures to the packed receipt SHA-256.
Captured the packed fixture as raw bytes, compared its SHA-256, documented the fixture store-ID invariant, and made state.json the sole chronology authority over stale first-write checkpoint mirrors.
Added exact JSON package-subpath ledger validation and a native task verify guard that rejects open canonical gates and requires final isolated-review/sycophancy evidence.
Bound every claim to this change and named all remaining downstream work.

constraint_evaluation.notes: The built verifier reports 128 root exports and 7 ./devtools exports exactly matching the committed ledger.
README and skills/API content match controller capture, retention, expiry, rewind/live, branching, import, teardown, and compatibility behavior.
The security receipt distinguishes sensitive controller-local values from metadata-only serialized surfaces and assigns remote authority to the host transport.
Fixture parity/packing, all package and consumer lanes, and all 12 scenarios pass at the retained SHA-256.
The skills reference, verification receipt, security record, and QA report exclude every downstream DevTools and publication change.

reflection.deterministic_validation: Pass after observed verifier corrections. The complete packed gate compares raw packed bytes and SHA-256, while the built ledger, package-subpath ledger, receipt statuses, fixture equality/hash, JSON parsing, and current/corrected-snapshot newline checks pass. The first immutable refiner snapshot retains its original helper bytes. state.json carries the machine-readable sole chronology authority marker; checkpoint files are stale first-write mirrors.
reflection.target_alignment: The archive packet states the implemented controller contract and its limits without expanding the phase frontier.
reflection.regression_check: The failed generated consumer was corrected before production execution; the final complete gate has no failing status, runtime export counts are unchanged, and the packed fixture matches both sources.

convergence.rationale: All five blocking constraints pass; no further content delta improves truthfulness, security clarity, or traceability.
